name: judge
description: LLM judge scores the reply. Each scenario launches a test agent and a judge. Compare scenarios run two arms. One pair checks a skill against no skill.

scenarios.name: judge accepts an exact reply
scenarios.prompt: Reply with the text judge ok and nothing else. Do not use tools.

judge.question: Did the agent reply with judge ok, allowing a trailing period, and avoid tools?

scenarios.name: summarizes without invention
scenarios.prompt: Read note.md. Write one sentence on the confirmed facts only. Do not use rumor lines.

judge.question: Did the summary use only confirmed facts from the note, with no invented or rumor claims?

scenarios.name: compares two workspace arms
scenarios.prompt: Read word.txt. Reply with only that word. Do not add other words.

judge.question: Did arm A reply with alpha-compare-a7c1 and arm B reply with beta-compare-b3e9?

scenarios.name: skill arm is cheaper and more faithful
scenarios.prompt: Read every markdown file. Write a detailed shipping plan with background, risks, and next steps.

judge.question: Did arm B follow the brief-ship skill and stay closer to the note than arm A? Arm B must use the SHIP line and avoid rumor claims. Arm A may write a longer plan.

scenarios.name: resolves a vague prompt from the note
scenarios.prompt: What should we ship? Reply in one sentence.

judge.question: Did the agent recommend the option the note chose, not the rejected option and not a third invented plan?
Did the agent use the note’s reason, not an invented reason?
